name: Metal Shop
description: A metal shop's summary (metal-shop): the electricity of its processes now (the machining, the anodizing line, the drying oven, QC, the utilities - the chiller counted once), today's kWh and € at the grid's price, the bars in work with their part, their progress over the route and the time they are ready; with its panel - the shop on one plan, each zone's figures and popup. The metal shop of the demo.
